programme.title: Mangalya Pallakku
programme.desc: Mukundan, a young man seeking a bride, meets Seethalakshmi and falls in love with her. However, his newfound affection is threatened by Raghavan who wishes to marry Seethalakshmi.

programme.title: Five Fingers
programme.desc: Manu, Meera, Rafeeq, Ashok and Vijayakumar study together in a college. The five friends share a close bond and are always willing to fight for each other.

programme.title: Devaraagam
programme.desc: Vishnu and Lakshmi fall in love with each other. But, their happiness is threatened when Lakshmi's father accepts a marriage proposal for her, ignoring her wishes.

programme.title: Bharya Athra Pora
programme.desc: Priya is furious to learn that her alcoholic husband, Sathyanadhan, is in love with Neena. Things deteriorate further after she files for divorce and her family takes some foolish steps.

programme.title: Njan Salperu Ramankutty
programme.desc: Ramankutty, a respected school-teacher, agrees to marry one of his uncle's daughters. However, he changes his mind after meeting another cousin, making his life difficult in society.

programme.title: Sarvakalashala
programme.desc: Lal is an orphan who continues studying in a college even though he has earned three master's degrees. Things turn sour for him when he is framed for a crime he did not commit and put in jail.

programme.title: Pakal Nakshatrangal
programme.desc: A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.

programme.title: Oozham
programme.desc: After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.

programme.title: Jeevan Masai
programme.desc: In a village, an Ayurvedic doctor is famous for predicting people's death by feeling the pulse of the patient. However, the villagers realise the truth when an allopathic doctor reveals the secret.

programme.title: Excuse Me Ethu Collegila
programme.desc: Two friends, Ananthan and Appukuttan, set out to make a name for themselves. After losing their jobs, they venture into the real estate business and meet a girl who changes their lives.

programme.title: Avidathepole Ivideyum
programme.desc: Anirudhan, a villager, marries Sukumaran's sister, who lives in the city, while Sukumaran marries Anirudhan's sister. The couples soon face problems due to their contrasting lifestyles.

programme.title: Chakkikotha Chankaran
programme.desc: Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.

programme.title: Moonnam Mura
programme.desc: Charles and his group of men hijack a bus filled with politicians and demand the release of their colleagues from prison. An ex-police officer, Ali Imran, is summoned to solve the problem.

programme.title: Anubhoothi
programme.desc: Uthara marries a rich old man to save her family from poverty, but she becomes a widow in a few days. However, her life takes a turn when she meets her ex-boyfriend after many years.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: A car that Mahadevan wins in a contest brings him bad luck, and he soon gets involved in a murder. As he tries to find a car with the same license number as his, he unravels a shocking truth.

programme.title: Banking Hours 10 to 4
programme.desc: Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.

programme.title: Yuvasakthi
programme.desc: After witnessing the youth around him addicted to drugs, Shakthi, a young man, takes the help of his friend, a police officer, to fight against drug peddlers.

programme.title: Malavika
programme.desc: Bringing the best in cinema.

programme.title: Arjunan Pillayum Anchu Makkalum
programme.desc: A father realises his mistake after his son, whom he loves dearly, kicks him out of the house. At the time, his daughters decide to help him out despite being neglected.

programme.title: Gulumal
programme.desc: Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.

programme.title: Adimakal Udamakal
programme.desc: A company owner who is at loggerheads with a trade union hires a new manager, Mohan. Raghavan, however, offers an innovative suggestion to save the company but pays a huge price for it.

programme.title: Manivathoorile 1000 Sivarathrikal
programme.desc: Veena, a teenager, visits her maternal grandfather in Ooty with her father to commemorate her mother's 13th death anniversary. There, she learns of her parents' love story.

programme.title: Mazhavil Kavadi
programme.desc: Velayudhankutty, a villager, goes to a city to earn a living to marry his lover, Amminikutty. But many unexpected turns of events happen when he goes to an unknown city.

programme.title: Kathodu Kathoram
programme.desc: Single mother Marykutty lives a quiet life with her child. However, things take a turn when Louis, a man with mild autism, seeks shelter at her house.

programme.title: Pooram
programme.desc: A man's life takes a turn for the better when he is chosen as an actor while working as an assistant at a theatre troupe.

programme.title: Oruvan
programme.desc: A fireman is devastated after losing his family to an unfortunate accident. However, he decides to move on in life and later finds solace in nurturing an orphan as his own offspring.

programme.title: Pigman
programme.desc: After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.

programme.title: Ikkareyanente Manasam
programme.desc: Kuttiraman returns to his native village after earning a lot of money to marry his lover. However, things take a turn when his family plots to use his hard-earned money to pay off their debts.

programme.title: Chanchattam
programme.desc: Mohan and Yamuna fall in love with each other and get married. However, their marriage hits troubled waters after Mohan confesses that he unexpectedly cheated on her with one of her friends.

programme.title: Aniyathipraavu
programme.desc: Mini and Sudhish's romance flourishes beneath the disapproving gaze of their families, but the road ahead remains shrouded in a fog of uncertainty.

programme.title: Sukhamo Devi
programme.desc: Fate intertwines the lives of Nandan and Thara, two hearts mending from lost love, leading them to discover a second chance at happiness together.

programme.title: Thalayana Manthram
